name: Nachi Yuuka
source:
Works as the dormitory superintendent. Since she has the best cooking at the dorms, everyone gets excited when it's her turn.

The person who admitted to Kei that the dormitory was meant to be girls-only. She shows no vigilance to the new boy, and acts like a gentle older sister to him. Occasionally makes a black aura.
